remarks: Stunning 4 bedroom, 2 full bath home in Broad River! - Totally renovated kitchen features white shaker-style cabinets, quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, and subway tile backsplash! - Open concept kitchen / dining / living room, great for entertaining! - Both bathrooms have been updated - Hardwood floors throughout! - Huge finished lower level offers much more living space and lots of options including family room, home gym, etc. - Large patio with custom pergola leads out to private back yard space! - Central air & LED lighting - Cat or small dog considered on case by case basis $50 / month
